channel.title: InYourBones Daily Music News
channel.description: Top 5 daily music stories handpicked by InYourBones

item.title: Poison the Well and Alexisonfire Announce Co-Headlining 2027 Tour with Support from Touché Amoré
item.description: Heavy-hitters unite! Poison the Well and Alexisonfire are teaming up for a 2027 co-headlining tour, with Touché Amoré along for the ride 🤘

item.title: Sublime Playing ’40 Oz.,’ ‘Sublime’ In Full At Red Rocks
item.description: Two iconic albums, one legendary venue 🌄 Sublime is bringing ’40 Oz. and Sublime to life in full at Red Rocks! 🎶

item.title: BTS Plans to Add More ARIRANG Tour Dates & Work on New Music & Solo Projects in 2027
item.description: BTS has a packed 2027 in the works: more ARIRANG tour dates, new music, and solo projects on the horizon 💜🎶

item.title: The Cure’s Robert Smith Promises More Concerts and New Music in 2027
item.description: Robert Smith says The Cure have more concerts and new music on the way in 2027. The Cure is very much not over! 🖤🎶

item.title: Watch Aerosmith return for first show in three years – with Dave Grohl on drums
item.description: Aerosmith are back onstage—and Dave Grohl took the drum throne! What a rock ’n’ roll reunion 🎸🥁
